item.title: Emergency Services Attending Crash In Ennis
item.description: Emergency servcies are at the scene of a two-car collision in Ennis. The incident occurred near the Inver filling station on the Lahinch Road, just off the Claureen Roundabout. Gardaí are advising motorists to take alternative routes if possible due to significant traffic delays. No injuries have been reported.
